mapper.insert: insert into `order` (order_no, goods_id, seller_id, buyer_id, amount, status, expire_time, version, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{orderNo}, #{goodsId}, #{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{expireTime}, #{version}, now(), now(), #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.update: update `order` set status = #{newStatus}, pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and status = #{oldStatus}
mapper.select: select * from `order` where status = 0 and expire_time < #{now} order by expire_time asc
mapper.update: update `order` set status = #{newStatus}, close_time = #{closeTime}, update_time = now(), version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and status = #{oldStatus}
mapper.select: select o.id, o.order_no, o.goods_id, o.seller_id, o.buyer_id, o.amount, o.status, o.expire_time, o.pay_time, o.close_time, o.complete_time, o.create_time, os.goods_title, os.goods_cover, os.goods_price, os.seller_name, os.seller_phone, os.buyer_name, os.buyer_phone, os.meet_location, os.meet_time, os.remark from `order` o left join order_snapshot os on o.id = os.order_id where o.id = #{id}

select o.id, o.order_no, o.goods_id, o.seller_id, o.buyer_id, o.amount, o.status, o.expire_time, o.pay_time, o.close_time, o.complete_time, o.create_time, os.goods_title, os.goods_cover, os.goods_price, os.seller_name, os.seller_phone, os.buyer_name, os.buyer_phone, os.meet_location, os.meet_time, os.remark from `order` o left join order_snapshot os on o.id = os.order_id where 1 = 1
and o.status = #{dto.status}
and o.order_no like concat('%', #{dto.orderNo}, '%')
order by o.create_time desc

select o.id, o.order_no, o.goods_id, o.seller_id, o.buyer_id, o.amount, o.status, o.expire_time, o.pay_time, o.close_time, o.complete_time, o.create_time, os.goods_title, os.goods_cover, os.goods_price, os.seller_name, os.seller_phone, os.buyer_name, os.buyer_phone, os.meet_location, os.meet_time, os.remark, p.id as pay_id, p.pay_no, p.status as pay_status, p.method as pay_method, p.pay_time as pay_record_time from `order` o left join order_snapshot os on o.id = os.order_id left join pay p on o.id = p.order_id where o.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update `order` set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update `order` set pay_time = #{payTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update `order` set complete_time = #{completeTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
update `order` set close_time = #{closeTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
